profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with over 25 years in analysis, design, development, testing and implementation of various types of visual applications, including multiplayer games, scalable lighting control applications and streaming media systems. I am a results-oriented developer comfortable switching between architecture, design, and implementation. I believe that learning should be a never-ending journey.

I make things go.
Views stated on LinkedIn are my own.
